name: competitors
title: Competition
description: Every competitor mention, with the buyer's actual relationship to it — an active user is not the same signal as someone migrating away.
prompt:
List every mention of a competing product or vendor, one entry per mention.

For each mention:
- evidence: cite the utterance(s), before you write "text".
- competitor: the competitor's name exactly as spoken in the transcript (lowercase if the transcript is lowercase). Never normalize to an official brand spelling the transcript doesn't contain.
- relationship: the buyer's actual relationship — "active_user" (using it today), "migrating_from" (leaving it), "evaluating" (considering it), "mentioned" (came up without a stated relationship). Distinguish carefully: an active user and someone migrating away are opposite signals.
- text: the mention in the speaker's exact words — no digit/number-word conversion, no paraphrase.

Only extract mentions actually in the transcript. A generic reference to "other tools" with no identifiable product is not a competitor mention. An empty list is a valid, correct result.
